title: Oscar and the Contact
author: Kestrel Coldharbour
blurb: Freya Brightwater, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
